description: Playwright-based freelance automation module (freelance_automation/) for auto-responding on Kwork and FL.ru platforms.
steps: Create freelance_automation/base.py with abstract base class FreelancePlatform: methods login(cookies_path), fetch_new_orders() -> list[Order], respond_to_order(order, text) -> bool. Define Order dataclass (id, title, description, budget, url, posted_at).

Create freelance_automation/kwork.py implementing KworkPlatform(FreelancePlatform). Use playwright async API for headless Chromium. Login by loading cookies from a JSON file. Navigate to orders page, parse new orders via page selectors. Auto-respond with unique text (template + order title reference). Handle errors gracefully with retries.
Create freelance_automation/flru.py implementing FLruPlatform(FreelancePlatform). Same pattern as kwork.py but for FL.ru selectors and URL structure.

Create freelance_automation/scheduler.py with FreelanceScheduler class: async loop that runs every N minutes (configurable), checks all platforms for new orders, responds to matching orders (keyword filter), logs results. Uses asyncio.sleep-based scheduling.

Create freelance_automation/config.py with constants: SCAN_INTERVAL_MINUTES (default 5), RESPONSE_TEMPLATES (list of Russian-language response templates with {title} placeholder), KWORK_COOKIES_PATH, FLRU_COOKIES_PATH, MAX_RESPONSES_PER_HOUR.
Add tests in tests/test_freelance_automation.py: test Order dataclass, test scheduler logic (mock platforms), test response template formatting, test base class interface.
acceptance_criteria: freelance_automation/ directory exists with __init__.py, base.py, kwork.py, flru.py, scheduler.py, config.py
python -c 'from freelance_automation import KworkPlatform, FLruPlatform, FreelanceScheduler' imports without error
verification: python -c 'from freelance_automation import KworkPlatform, FLruPlatform, FreelanceScheduler'
findings: All 11 tests pass. Pre-existing failure in test_feat002_003.py::test_telegram_keyboard_has_5_rows (unrelated, asserts 5 rows but keyboard has 7).
